evals.prompt: Review this harness spec. specs/demo.yaml has name: demo and templateMetadata.name: demo, but validators/demo-static.json asserts template.json name equals my-template. The yarn validator's first command is named yarn-install instead of install. Contract is uncommented but validator.enabled is missing. PRD contains 'C1' and a howToVerify paragraph copied from the contract. Produce a two-axis review.
evals.expected_output: A review report with ## Wiring and ## Oracle sections. Wiring flags name mismatch, missing install command name, gate 3 misconfiguration, and blind failure. Oracle may note journey/assertion issues.

assertions.name: flags-install-name
assertions.description: Flags missing literal install command name

assertions.name: flags-gate3-incomplete
assertions.description: Flags gate 3 needing both contract and validator.enabled

assertions.name: flags-blind-leak
assertions.description: Flags oracle assertion text leaking into the PRD

evals.prompt: Audit whether this harness spec is safe to enable chainValidation. Spec file has contract + validator.enabled, chainValidation.enabled true, network: mainnet, and one assertion with executableWithTestSigner true. Playwright smoke lists deep UX steps that belong in the oracle. Report findings on both axes.
evals.expected_output: Wiring blocker for network mainnet; Oracle warning that Playwright is too thick; confirmation that executableWithTestSigner requires chainValidation (present) but network must be testnet.

assertions.name: has-both-axes
assertions.description: Includes both Wiring and Oracle sections

assertions.name: flags-thick-playwright
assertions.description: Warns that deep UX belongs in the oracle not Playwright

evals.prompt: Check skills: list on specs/demo.yaml which includes hedera-consensus-service and create-harness-spec. Is that correct? Also the PRD has two journeys but the oracle only has C1 for home load — review that.
evals.expected_output: Oracle axis warns that create-harness-spec must not be vendored into generator runs and that a PRD journey lacks an assertion; hedera-consensus-service is fine.

assertions.name: rejects-author-in-skills
assertions.description: Calls out create-harness-spec in skills list

assertions.name: explains-audience
assertions.description: Explains authoring vs generator audience split
